about: Card helper-tape-handover. Not read from the live helper (helper update 23 was deploying and measuring on 22 Nov when the card was built; the live helper was off limits): both runs come from the helper's own code on the recorded Base hour (apps/helper/test/evm-swaps/base.ts, fixtures/swaps-base-hour.json.gz), made by the card's scratch script and shaped as read() records them. Base only: no Robinhood recording of a deploy exists. The first deploy's live run with --record replaces them. Card helper-tape-handover-judges-handed-books: each answer now keeps its Server-Timing (`timing`), in the shape the helper's trades answer writes it (apps/helper/src/data/evm/swaps-books-handover.test.ts: a restored book's answer ends in evm-handed, a cold one's does not). The good run's answers are marked handed over, as that test reads them. The bad run is planted: the no-handover run's short ICNT answer marked handed over, a restored book that answered short. The cold run is that no-handover run as it was, unmarked.

good.what: a helper 120 s old restored from the old one's warm-file books (swaps.ts restore): ICNT and VVV each answer their 50 rows at the first read, the same rows a read later; every answer marked handed over (evm-handed)
